verdict.rationale: Mailchimp's own materials say it offers automations: the homepage markets 'automations', the pricing page lists 'Enhanced automations', and Analytics AI reports on which automations drive revenue. A community comment also mentions building a Mailchimp automation. None of this describes multi-step flows, welcome/onboarding/winback series, branching, delays, or exit rules. missing for 10: documentation of multi-step journey building, conditional branches, time delays, exit/goal rules, lifecycle templates (welcome, onboarding, winback), and hands-on corroboration.
